'''2000 Dantooine Regionals''' was the Star Wars CCG regional championship for the Dantooine region (Arkansas, Louisiana, Oklahoma, Texas) in the 2000 Decipher championship circuit.<ref name="dc00fin">[http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html DecipherCon 2000: Star Wars CCG Qualifiers], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010308110320/http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="rl00dantooine">[http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=dantooine 2000 Regionals: Dantooine], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010726144811/http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=dantooine Internet Archive]</ref>

[[Frank Truong]] of Houston, Texas won and qualified for the [[2000 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dc00fin" />

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional championship
* '''Date:''' 25 June 2000
* '''Site:''' Houston, Texas
